rationale: The listener liked AD14 maracas but found them a bit too loud, then said of AD11: In the second one, I can barely hear the maracas. AD12 measured a 3.048 dB energy reduction, just outside the frozen 1–3 dB target. Use the single milder AD13 alternative with A1/S0/R0 retained. Preserve source attacks, gate schedule and tonal balance; require 1–3 dB lower noise energy than AD14 and energy strictly between AD14 and AD11.
scope: One intermediate native hook balance awaiting listening feedback. Preserve both earlier candidates; no full-song rollout, PCM gain adjustment or new rhythm.
